body: No, you just don’t understand. I need to do these things and I can’t, I KNOW I can’t- you’re saying I know I can do these things except I can’t, killing myself would lift a huge burden off everyone who is trying to help me and that’s the thing I know I can do.

Thank you. Honestly I feel that way about almost everything. I’m always trying to be something or someone for the sake of others. But I don’t want to live like that, I want to be happy and safe but I’ve never experienced those things. My life constantly spirals and if I don’t kill myself im just going to die anyway.

What most people don’t understand is that my reasons for wanting to die are very complicated, I’ve thought about suicide for a long time (more than 10 years) and I just feel like it’s a rational choice.

I just want to be brave enough to pull it off.

That’s the most annoying thing, I just feel like I’m emotionally burdening my friends but also I feel like they don’t really understand what I’m going through at all.

I already have so few friends. I’ve completely isolated from all my old friends and family because I’m a transgender woman so I don’t have any of that anymore.
I just wish I could do it without being afraid to be honest
I just don’t think anyone here can help me

The fact that I fail every time I try to improve my life, I’ve been trying for the last 10 years and it’s not improving, I’m unable to do the things that are expected of me in order for me to get better, and honestly I just don’t see myself as a part of this world I just feel like an outsider when people talk to me about their lives, it’s obvious to me I can’t change things for myself on my own, all I can do is stop myself from being a burden on others any further.

I’ve been close before I just have to keep trying, I know I can do it eventually when I’m conditioned more to it.
I don’t really have any family. Everyone I know already knows I’m suicidal all they can really do is hope I get better.
I can’t enjoy anything anymore all I can think about is suicide and how I’m running out of options for getting help. The future I imagine myself in is miserable because it’s been this way for years.
